- `ListShortcuts` (`ListShortcutsRequest` → `ListShortcutsResponse`, `GET /api/v1/{parent=users/*}/shortcuts`)
- `GetShortcut` (`GetShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut`, `GET /api/v1/{name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`)
- `CreateShortcut` (`CreateShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut`, `POST /api/v1/{parent=users/*}/shortcuts`)
- `UpdateShortcut` (`UpdateShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut`, `PATCH /api/v1/{shortcut.name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`)
- `DeleteShortcut` (`DeleteShortcutRequest` → `google.protobuf.Empty`, `DELETE /api/v1/{name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`)

**Implementing file:** `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` — all five are methods on `APIV1Service` there (`ListShortcuts` at line 49, `GetShortcut` at 95, `CreateShortcut` at 135, `UpdateShortcut` at 211, `DeleteShortcut` at 284).

Two supporting files sit in front of that implementation rather than containing it: `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (lines 526–566) has thin `ConnectServiceHandler` wrappers that unwrap the Connect request and delegate to the `APIV1Service` methods, and `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` embeds `v1pb.UnimplementedShortcutServiceServer` and registers the gRPC-gateway handler (line 117).
